story.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛赢家与输家盘点
story.summaryZh: The 比赛团队对2026年F1西班牙大奖赛进行赢家与输家盘点，指出在马德里赛道的首场F1比赛中真正的赢家不多，连获胜者本人都觉得自己应该排在第二位。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
story.summaryEn: The Race team reviews the winners and losers from the 2026 Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, noting that there were not many true winners at the first F1 race at the Madring, and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
detailZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛没有多少赢家——甚至真正的比赛获胜者都觉得自己其实应该排在第二位。
以下是我们完整的赢家与输家盘点。
一场本应赢下的比赛，因此也不应该有一辆车只拿到第八名。真是办公室里的艰难一天。
虚拟安全车让赛道上除兰多·诺里斯之外的每辆车都获得了优势，这是唯一的问题。他开得几乎完美，擦到7号弯护墙是他唯一的瑕疵，看起来他已经稳操胜券，却在之后被夺走。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的比赛要复杂得多。第一圈与乔治·拉塞尔碰撞导致的受损前翼到底对他有多大影响？而他在最后阶段被加布里埃尔·博托莱托和弗兰科·科拉平托挡在身后，究竟该归咎于他缺乏速度、进站，还是迈凯伦的策略团队？车队选择让他进站，明知他可能被困在那群车中。
皮亚斯特里在2026款赛车上相对诺里斯一直很挣扎，但即便在这种情况下，这个周末也感觉很糟糕。——杰克·贝尼昂
刘易斯·汉密尔顿起步时确实没有犯错。他起步比马克斯·维斯塔潘快，荷兰人在切过开场减速弯后最终不得不让出位置。
随后长长的刹车踏板行程迅速变成故障，汉密尔顿不得不停下他的法拉利。
“进入5号弯刹车时，我踩了刹车，车开始减速，然后踏板突然一沉，车没有像正常那样快速减速，我最终带着很高的速度冲了进去……擦到了护墙。”
“之后踏板恢复了，一切正常，但几个弯之后踏板又变长了。真的不知道这是从哪里来的，”这是汉密尔顿的事后分析。
本可能是领奖台的成绩变成了退赛，这位车手随后承认安东内利在冠军争夺中不可阻挡。
考虑到迈凯伦的研发速度，这对法拉利来说可能是一次刺痛的积分损失——他们在争夺年度亚军的优势现在缩小到了52分。——萨马斯·卡纳尔
又一场比赛，又一个冠军给基米·安东内利——又一次利用了虚拟安全车。
安东内利这次不需要在赛道上超车，因为首先杆位得主诺里斯的比赛因虚拟安全车出动时机稍晚而崩盘，他晚一圈的进站也很慢。
然后查尔斯·勒克莱尔因放弃了虚拟安全车期间的进站，不得不在比赛后期让出领先位置。
低轮胎磨损、缺乏超车机会以及迈凯伦不幸的时机和糟糕的策略，使这场比赛成为安东内利本赛季最不引人注目的胜利。
他在胜利中表现得很有风度，说他为诺里斯“感到有点难过”，并称这位迈凯伦车手本应是当之无愧的赢家。
凭借这场胜利，梅赛德斯追平法拉利，成为动力单元制造商中大奖赛胜场最多的品牌（251胜）。
更重要的是，安东内利目前积292分，而队友乔治·拉塞尔为211分。
他有望以相当大的优势成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。——SK
这位马德里赛道赛事大使从未期待过一场特别有竞争力的主场比赛，但他本希望周日不会像这样充满事故。
第一圈开始，他笨拙地撞上了角田裕毅的小红牛，随后又将同胞费尔南多·阿隆索挤到墙上。
幸运的是，卡洛斯·塞恩斯至少能在退赛前服完处罚——所以不会带到巴库——但这为这个令人失望且草率的周末画上了句号。——乔什·萨蒂尔
在蒙扎的最坏情况之后，人们曾希望马德里赛道能为阿斯顿·马丁提供一个更好的机会，像在赞德沃特那样争夺积分。
但这从未实现，也看起来不太可能。他肯定没有得到帮助，因为阿隆索被塞恩斯挤压后带着损伤，这使得很难知道阿斯顿·马丁在这里的真实潜力。
“今天引擎非常糟糕，”阿隆索说。“我认为今天的增压控制很困难。我在进站时差点熄火。”
“还有蓝旗的时候，让车减速。引擎在那之后很难恢复，所以我在蓝旗上损失了很多时间。”
他最终落后两圈，以第17名完赛，而兰斯·斯特罗尔在57圈比赛的第15圈就驶离了赛道。——JS
科拉平托以第七名领跑中游集团，表现稳健。
他带领一列中游赛车在斯特罗尔引发的虚拟安全车期间进站，然后在最后阶段向博托莱托施压并挡住了皮亚斯特里。
虽然一度与皮亚斯特里的差距是三秒——科拉平托在压力下面对一辆快得多的赛车时巧妙地扩大了差距——但差距在最后确实缩小了。但这并不改变这一成就的分量。
科拉平托现在在车手积分榜上仅落后第11名的阿尔维德·林德布拉德四分，而阿尔派在争夺车队第五名时与小红牛的差距已从13分缩小到9分。——JB
马德里赛道这个周末做了很多正确的事，但很难将首场F1比赛描述为除了沉闷之外的任何东西。
赛道缺乏超车机会肯定没有帮助，缺乏显著的轮胎磨损也没有帮助。
但也许最痛苦的是，这正是许多F1车手在布局公布时警告会发生的情况。
所以，尽管马德里赛道做了很多伟大的事情，首届赛事最可能被记住的，是它令人失望的周日产品。——JS
detailEn: Not many winners from Formula 1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix - and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.
Here's our full winners and losers rundown.
A race it should have won, and therefore not had a car finishing eighth in, either. A really tough day at the office.

The VSC giving an advantage to every other car on track apart from Lando Norris was the sole issue. He drove almost perfectly, a clip of the Turn 7 wall his only blemish as he appeared to have the race sewn up before it was taken from him.

Oscar Piastri's race was much more complicated. How much did the damaged wing from clashing with George Russell on lap one really hamper him? And was it his lack of pace, the pitstop, or McLaren's strategy bods to blame for him being caught behind Gabriel Bortoleto and Franco Colapinto in the closing stages? It chose to pit him, knowing being stuck in that pack was a possibility.
Piastri has struggled relative to Norris with the 2026 car, but this felt like a poor weekend even in the circumstances. - Jack Benyon
Lewis Hamilton didn't really put a foot wrong at the start. He was quicker than Max Verstappen off the line and the Dutchman did eventually have to concede after cutting the opening chicane.
Then a long brake pedal quickly turned into a malfunction and Hamilton had to stop his Ferrari.

"Braking into Turn 5, I had hit the brake, the car started stopping and then the pedal took a step and the car didn't decelerate as fast as it would normally and I ended up carrying a lot of speed in and… brushed the barrier.
"After that, the pedal came back, it was fine, and then a few corners later the pedal went long. Don't really know where that's come from," was Hamilton's post-mortem.
What could have been a podium finish turned into a DNF for the driver, who then conceded that Antonelli was unstoppable in the title race.
Given McLaren's rate of development, it could prove to be a stinging points loss for Ferrari - whose advantage in their fight for second in the championship is now down to 52 points. - Samarth Kanal
Another race, another win for Kimi Antonelli - and another VSC capitalised upon.
Antonelli didn't need to make an overtake on track for this one, as first polesitter Norris's race unravelled as the VSC was deployed a moment too late and his pitstop one lap later was slow.
Then Charles Leclerc had to relinquish the lead late in the race having forgone the VSC pitstop.
Low tyre degradation, a lack of overtaking opportunities and McLaren's unfortunate timing and poor strategy made this one Antonelli's least remarkable win of the season.
He was gracious in victory, saying he "felt a bit bad" for Norris and that the McLaren driver would've been the deserving winner.
With victory here, Mercedes has tied Ferrari for most grand prix wins by a power unit manufacturer (251).
More consequentially, Antonelli is on 292 points to team-mate George Russell's 211.
He's on course to become F1's youngest world champion by some margin. - SK
The Madring event ambassador was never expecting a particularly competitive home grand prix, but he'd have hoped for better than an incident-filled Sunday.
It began on lap one with a rather clumsy first lap where he clunked into Yuki Tsunoda's Racing Bulls, and was followed by squeezing his fellow countryman Fernando Alonso into the wall.
Thankfully Carlos Sainz was at least able to serve that penalty before he retired - so it won't carry over to Baku - but it rounded off a disappointing and sloppy weekend. - Josh Suttill
After the worst-case scenario at Monza, there was hope the Madring would provide a better chance for Aston Martin to challenge for points like at Zandvoort.

But it never materialised nor looked likely. He certainly wasn't helped by Alonso carrying damage from Sainz squeezing him, and that makes it particularly hard to know the true potential of the Aston Martin here.
"The engine was very bad today," Alonso said. "I think the boost control was difficult today. I nearly stalled on the pitstops.
"With some of the blue flags as well, letting the people go and slowing down. The engine was struggling to recover after that, so I was losing a lot of time on the blue flags.
He ultimately finished two laps down in 17th while Lance Stroll pulled off the track 15 laps into the 57-lap race. - JS
Colapinto led the midfield with an accomplished drive to seventh.
He led a train of mid-pack cars that pitted under the Stroll-induced VSC, and then pressured Bortoleto and held off Piastri in the closing stages.

While the gap was three seconds at one point to Piastri - expertly extended by Colapinto under pressure from what was a much quicker car - it did come down towards the end. But that doesn't change the scale of the achievement.

Colapinto's only four points off 11th-placed Arvid Lindblad in the drivers' championship now, and Alpine's gap to Racing Bulls in the chase for fifth in the constructors' has reduced from 13 to nine. - JB
The Madring did plenty right this weekend, but it's difficult to describe the first F1 race as anything but dull.
The lack of overtaking opportunities around the circuit certainly didn't help, nor did the lack of significant tyre degradation.
But what's perhaps most painful is that this is exactly what many F1 drivers warned would happen when the layout was revealed.
So for all the great things the Madring has done, the first event will most likely be best remembered for its underwhelming Sunday product. - JS
keyPointsZh: 安东内利获胜后，梅赛德斯以251胜追平法拉利，成为动力单元制造商中大奖赛胜场最多的品牌。
安东内利目前积292分，领先队友拉塞尔211分，有望成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
科拉平托以第七名领跑中游集团，阿尔派在车队积分榜上追近小红牛，差距从13分缩小到9分。
keyPointsEn: After Antonelli's win, Mercedes tied Ferrari for most grand prix wins by a power unit manufacturer with 251.
Antonelli now has 292 points to teammate Russell's 211 and is on course to become F1's youngest world champion by some margin.
Colapinto led the midfield with a seventh-place finish, and Alpine's gap to Racing Bulls in the fight for fifth in the constructors' championship has reduced from 13 to nine points.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
